recipes.name: Easy Sweet and Sour Chicken
ingredients_raw: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps.text: Combine flour, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in a shallow dish. Roll chicken in flour mixture to coat.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken; cook and stir until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 8 to 10 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in the same skillet over medium heat. Add celery, bell peppers, and onion; cook and stir until slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, whisk ketchup, lemon juice, pineapple with syrup, and brown sugar together in a bowl.
Return chicken to the skillet, pour in pineapple mixture, and bring to a boil. Cook and stir chicken and vegetables in the sauce until heated through, 2 to 3 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Sweet and Sour Chicken
raw_recipe.description: This quick and easy sweet and sour chicken recipe is sure to become a favorite with everyone at your table, and it’s ready to eat in under an hour!

video.description: Nothing quite like the flavors of sweet and sour chicken! Tangy ketchup, sweet crushed pineapple, lemon, and brown sugar make a delicious sweet and sour sauce!

review.reviewBody: Easy to make and tastes WONDERFUL. I made a few changes, only out of necessity. With changes or not, your family will love this dish. I used fresh pineapple instead of canned crushed. I added some water with a bit extra sugar since I didn't have the syrup from the canned pineapple. Also, I cut the pineapple into chunks. I prefer chunky pineapple in my sauce. Of course, I couldn't whisk the mixture, but stirring worked fine too. I had planned to take a photo to post, but my family devoured it before I could. Also, I didn't dice the green pepper. I cut it (and the celery) into julienne strips. The times are pretty much right on target. You can make this dinner in under 30 minutes and your family will think you worked really hard!!

This makes your chicken pieces very tender if you cook it long enough. I skipped the salt and instead used 1 clove fresh garlic and soy sauce. I made the sauce and heated it in a saucepan and then combined the prepared the chicken pieces in dish in the oven for 20 minutes.

Fantastic! The first time I followed the recipe exactly. The second time I doubled the sauce and more than doubled the pineapple. I added 3 tbs cornstarch and water to thicken it at the end. We liked it even better with more sauce. I will make this regularly. Thanks for the recipe!

After I read the reviews, I decided to make this recipe even though I have never made sweet and sour sauce without soya sauce. I used more chicken breast, and instead of using flour, I made a gluten free version - sprinkled garlic salt all over the chicken then 2 T tapioca starch rather than the flour. I omitted the green pepper, instead used 1/2 red pepper, carrots, half an onion, all julienned, celery and pea pods. I had fresh sweet pineapple so for the sauce, I used 1/3 c ketchup, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar, 1/4 cup lemon juice and a scant amount of tapioca starch to thicken. I would definitely make this again - my husband loved it! Thanks for the recipe!

I made it family friendly for my family which included no celery or onion. I did add some some celery salt and onion powder two my sauteing peppers. Garlic salt and black pepper with the flour for the coating on the chicken. I also used half of an orange , red and yellow pepper instead of green pepper. All other ingredients the same.
I used only green peppers and pineapple chunks. It was delicious. Everyone loved it. I added a little Corn Starch to thicken the sauce since I used 16 oz can with the juice

I cook for a crew of 7 on an ocean going tug, Chinese take out is a favorite for the guys when we hit the dock, but with this recipe I can bring that dock side comfort food to the galley table anytime, and its better than carry out. Its a little bit of prep, and i recommend having everything preped for a easier cooking experience, also i marinated my chicken chunks for about 2 hours in a little bit of reduced sodium soy sauce mixed with water (1 to 1 ratio) before breading....10 out of 10 highly recommend 👌 👏 👍🏻 😎

It's really authentic and easy. Almost tastes like my dad's. I used some apple cider vinegar (about 1/4 of a cup) in lieu of pineapples/pineapple syrup. And I cooked my chicken well done in the wok to achieve a crispy chicken texture (another bonus; everything in the wok meal!).

Excellent recipe...made some changes...first I added a bit of cornstarch to the flour when coating the chicken breast pieces. I put dry ingredients in plastic bag and it was quicker and less messy to coat all pieces at once. I only used three chicken cutlets. Also, We do not like green peppers or celery so I used frozen veggies...I rinsed 1 whole bag of frozen broccoli florets and half a bag of frozen red peppers under hot water and let them drain well- did not cook them until I added to recipe. .I also used sliced pineapple in heavy syrup. I minced the slices and added the syrup to the liquid sauce mixture as recipe states. Added leftover slices on top. After stir frying chicken pieces, I removed them and then added broccoli , peppers and fresh onion to pan. After five minutes of stir frying, I returned chicken and followed recipe as is. We loved it! Very flavorful!

It's a lovely recipes. I just made some changes: I added soya sauce, corn starch and vinegar instead of ketchup and lime. I also marinated the chicken for half an hour first in salt pepper and garlic powder. It was very tasty.

Didn’t have pineapple so substituted one of my toddler’s peach fruit cups instead. Threw all ingredients into a bullet blender. Also opted for un-breaded chicken breast. Super easy & VERY good. Served over top of Knorr cheddar broccoli rice.

It's easy and once you do the prep, it's fast to make. This is the second time I've made this dish. Very tasty. I did add a little extra pineapple and had to use white sugar, but it was still delicious.
This recipe was very easy and delicious. I had my doubts with the ingredients, but it was perfect the way it was.
Love it and very easy.
Amazing recipe! From all of the sweet and sour chicken recipes this is probably the easiest and tastiest.

In a real pinch you can just use a drained can of chicken breast straight out of the can... no frying needed... I added a little cornstarch dissolved in water to thicken a bit, shaved at least 15 min off. It was still wonderful!
Too sweet, I will not add brown sugar next time.
We had fresh pineapple and that made some flavor changes. Next time I will add a little less lemon juice but otherwise a good recipe
I think it's so good! Prettymuch just left it the way it was 'cept for a mistake I made when I mixed two recipes together on accident. lol
Double the pineapple. You won't regret it.
